verdict.rationale: Recurly docs confirm usage-based billing with measured units and per-unit consumption charged at cycle end, plus subscription plan/price/quantity changes with proration and credit invoices — covering core usage-metering and plan-change basics. However there is no explicit evidence of tiered, volume, or graduated pricing tiers, minimum commitments, or overage-specific billing logic, which are core parts of the story. Missing for 10: tiered/volume/graduated pricing tier configuration, commitment/minimum-spend handling, explicit overage billing mechanics, and any no-code UI proof for building these hybrid models.
